messages:
eli-partnerships: FYI — BridgeWire reached out about packaging their BW-3B open weights as a bundled SKU for our cloud marketplace. They want us to rehost quantized weights and offer a HW-accelerated bundle with our preferred partner.

maria-ops: Do we have a precedent for a joint bundle where partner provides quantized artifacts and we do the marketplace listing + billing split? I can look up past contracts but want heads-up on red flags.

samir-legal: Quick read: we need to confirm redistribution rights (source vs weights), export control language, and whether the upstream model license allows commercial redistribution when repackaged. BridgeWire's repo says "Apache-2.0-like" but with a redistribution addendum — can you share the exact clause?

eli-partnerships: Pasted the clause they sent:

```
Redistribution: You may redistribute model weights in binary form provided attribution is preserved and a Redistribution Agreement is executed with the original author. Commercial redistribution requires a separate commercial license.
```

eli-partnerships: So they're saying commercial redistribution requires a separate license — they offered a revenue share for marketplace sales and suggested a simple addendum.

samir-legal: That's not sufficient. We need: explicit permission to rehost quantized/converted artifacts, permission for use on third-party hardware, and a warranty/indemnity carveout. Also export control: if weights are trained on regulated data, there may be EAR/ITAR implications.

laura-product: For product planning: if we rehost a quantized BW-3B and pair it with HW partner X's accelerator, we want a single SKU (BW-3B + HW-X accel) and an option for "software-only" (quantized weights) for Dedicated customers. Tim, is there anything blocking us from shipping quantized binaries in marketplace images?

tim-eng: Technically fine. We already support packaging quantized checkpoints and inference containers. Two asks:
- We need a definitive compatibility test from HW partner (driver/kernel matrix).
- A hash/signature on the provided artifacts so we can verify integrity across air-gapped installs.

maria-ops: Noted. Operationally we'll need the manifest fields for the SKU page: model size, quantization type (e.g., q4_0, q8_1), expected throughput on HW-X, memory footprint, and a tested latency profile. BridgeWire to provide reference perf numbers + test harness.

eli-partnerships: BridgeWire offered their perf sheet but it's noisy. I'll request a stripped-down harness (single-threaded infer script + sample prompts) and the exact quantization pipeline (scripts and versions).

samir-legal: Also ask for upstream attribution text and logo usage rules. Marketplace legal requires a one-paragraph license summary on the SKU page and a copy of any addendum stored in the contract folder.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please attach any external license docs to the partnership record. (link to GH: https://github.com/redwood/partnerships/tree/bridgewire)

laura-product: Marketing/announce question: BridgeWire wants a joint press mention on launch week. We should not promise public co-announcement until legal and export checks are cleared. Timeline estimate?

eli-partnerships: Tentative timeline if docs + artifacts come back in 5 business days: legal review (3 days), ops validation (4 days), HW partner perf validation (5 days) => ~2.5 weeks. Can compress if BridgeWire provides clean artifacts.

tim-eng: Can frontload compatibility tests in parallel with legal review. We'll spin a testing instance and invite HW partner to run quick kernels.

maria-ops: Action items I have:
- collect BridgeWire redistribution addendum and exact quant pipeline
- produce SKU manifest template for marketplace
- open ticket with infra to set up verification hash flow

samir-legal: My action items:
- draft a redistribution addendum that grants us rehosting rights for quantized artifacts, allows marketplace listing, clarifies revenue share, and includes export control representations
- confirm whether we need to escalate to compliance for export review

eli-partnerships: I'll ping BridgeWire and HW partner to request the missing items and propose the 2.5 week schedule. Also looping in @laura-product for go/no-go on joint announcement once legal signs off.

laura-product: Sounds good. If legal okays, we'll coordinate PR assets and a joint launch checklist (logos, copy, embargo timing).

tim-eng: Small note: if BridgeWire insists on proprietary quant scripts that we can't include in images, we need a documented install step for partners and a verification handshake. Flagging now.

eli-partnerships: Great catch. BridgeWire — can you confirm you'll provide either (a) redistributable quantized checkpoints + scripts under the addendum, or (b) reproducible scripts + seed/params so we can produce the binaries ourselves? We prefer (a) but (b) acceptable with integrity guarantees.

BridgeWire (external): Thanks — we'll push the quant artifacts and perf harness by EOD Thursday. We'll also sign an addendum allowing redistribution for marketplace with a 70/30 rev share proposal. We'll attach logo usage guidelines.

maria-ops: Perfect. Once we have artifacts I'll provision a validation instance and send you the SKU manifest template.

eli-partnerships: Closing loop: no public announcement until legal + compliance sign-off, but internal timeline stays. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
